documenttypes.updatedocumenttype affinda.api.documenttypes.updatedocumenttype tool to update a document type by its identifier. use when you need to modify the name or description of an existing document type. write

extractors.createextractor affinda.api.extractors.createextractor tool to create a new extractor. use when you need to define a custom document parser with specific fields and extraction rules, typically derived from a base extractor. write

extractors.deleteextractor affinda.api.extractors.deleteextractor permanently delete an extractor from affinda by its identifier. this is a destructive operation that cannot be undone. use get extractors first to verify the extractor id before deletion. note: this action is deprecated by the api. destructive

extractors.getextractor affinda.api.extractors.getextractor tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific extractor by its identifier. use when you need complete metadata about an extractor's configuration, fields, and capabilities. read

extractors.getextractors affinda.api.extractors.getextractors retrieve all extractors available for an organization. extractors are document parsing configurations that define what data to extract from documents. this includes both affinda's built-in extractors (resumes, invoices, etc.) and any custom extractors created for the organization. use this action to: - list available extractors before creating a collection - find the identifier of a specific extractor type - check if custom extractors exist for the organization read

extractors.updateextractor affinda.api.extractors.updateextractor tool to update specific fields of an extractor. use when you need to modify an extractor's name, category, validation settings, or field groups after creation. write

indexes.createindex affinda.api.indexes.createindex tool to create a new index for search and match functionality. use when you need to set up a new index for organizing and searching documents like resumes or job descriptions. write

indexes.deleteindex affinda.api.indexes.deleteindex tool to permanently delete an index from affinda by its name. use when you need to remove an index that is no longer needed. this is a destructive operation that cannot be undone. destructive

indexes.getindexdocuments affinda.api.indexes.getindexdocuments tool to retrieve all indexed documents for a specific index. use when you need to list documents in a search index after creating or accessing an index. read
indexes.listindexes affinda.api.indexes.listindexes tool to retrieve a list of all search indexes. use when you need to view available indexes for searching and matching documents in affinda. read
indexes.updateindex affinda.api.indexes.updateindex tool to update the name of an existing search index. use when you need to rename an index after creation. write

invitations.createinvitation affinda.api.invitations.createinvitation tool to create a new organization invitation. use when you need to invite a user to join an organization with a specific role. write

invitations.deleteinvitation affinda.api.invitations.deleteinvitation tool to delete an invitation by its identifier. use when you need to remove or revoke an invitation after confirming the invitation identifier. destructive

invitations.getallinvitations affinda.api.invitations.getallinvitations tool to retrieve all invitations you created or sent to you. use when you need to list organization invitations with optional filtering by status, role, or organization. read

invitations.getinvitation affinda.api.invitations.getinvitation tool to retrieve details of a specific organization invitation by its identifier. use when you need to check invitation status or get invitation metadata. read

invitations.updateinvitation affinda.api.invitations.updateinvitation tool to update an organization invitation's role. use when you need to change the role assigned to an invitation before it is accepted. write

jobdescriptionsearch.createjobdescriptionsearch affinda.api.jobdescriptionsearch.createjobdescriptionsearch search through parsed job descriptions using custom criteria or resume matching. use this action when you need to find job postings that match specific requirements such as skills, experience, location, education, or to find jobs matching a candidate's resume. returns ranked results with detailed match scores. write

jobdescriptionsearch.createjobdescriptionsearchembedurl affinda.api.jobdescriptionsearch.createjobdescriptionsearchembedurl tool to create and return a signed url for the embeddable job description search tool. use this when you need to generate a url that can be embedded on a web page to provide job description search functionality. optionally pass config_override to customize display settings, field weights, and theme. write

jobdescriptionsearch.getjobdescriptionsearchconfig affinda.api.jobdescriptionsearch.getjobdescriptionsearchconfig tool to get the configuration for the logged in user's embeddable job description search tool. returns display settings, field weights, and maximum results limits. #### output | parameter | type | required | description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | yes | data from the action execution | | `error` | string | no | error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | yes | whether or not the action execution was successful or not | read

jobdescriptionsearch.updatejobdescriptionsearchconfig affinda.api.jobdescriptionsearch.updatejobdescriptionsearchconfig tool to update the configuration for the logged in user's embeddable job description search tool. use to configure display fields, field weights, maximum results, and ui customization options. write

mappings.createmapping affinda.api.mappings.createmapping tool to create a custom mapping for a data source. use when you need to configure specific lookup settings for a mappingdatasource. note: this endpoint is deprecated. write

mappings.deletemapping affinda.api.mappings.deletemapping tool to delete a specific mapping by its identifier. use when you need to remove an unused or incorrect mapping from the database. note: this endpoint is deprecated. destructive

mappings.getmapping affinda.api.mappings.getmapping tool to retrieve a specific mapping by its identifier. use when you need to fetch mapping configuration details for a lookup against a mappingdatasource. read
mappings.listmappings affinda.api.mappings.listmappings tool to retrieve the list of all custom data mappings. use when you need to list mappings for a specific data source. read

mappings.updatemapping affinda.api.mappings.updatemapping tool to update a specific mapping's settings. use when you need to adjust score cutoff or ordering for a lookup against a mappingdatasource. write

occupationgroups.listoccupationgroups affinda.api.occupationgroups.listoccupationgroups tool to retrieve the list of searchable occupation groups. use when you need to get available occupation categories for job matching or classification. #### output | parameter | type | required | description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | yes | data from the action execution | | `error` | string | no | error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | yes | whether or not the action execution was successful or not | read

organizationmemberships.getallorganizationmemberships affinda.api.organizationmemberships.getallorganizationmemberships retrieve all organization memberships across the account. returns paginated results showing which users belong to which organizations. use to audit organization access or find specific user memberships. read

organizationmemberships.getorganizationmembership affinda.api.organizationmemberships.getorganizationmembership tool to retrieve details of a specific organization membership by its id. use when you need to confirm a user's role and details within an organization. read

organizationmemberships.updateorganizationmembership affinda.api.organizationmemberships.updateorganizationmembership tool to update an organization membership's role. use when you need to change a user's role within an organization. write

organizations.createorganization affinda.api.organizations.createorganization tool to create a new organization. use when you have a unique organization name and want to group resources under it. write

organizations.deleteorganization affinda.api.organizations.deleteorganization permanently deletes an organization from affinda. this action is destructive and cannot be undone. all workspaces, collections, and documents associated with the organization will also be deleted. use the get_organizations action first to confirm the organization identifier before deletion. destructive

organizations.getorganization affinda.api.organizations.getorganization tool to retrieve details of a specific organization by its id. use when you need to fetch an organization's metadata after confirming its identifier. read

organizations.getorganizations affinda.api.organizations.getorganizations retrieves all organizations accessible to the authenticated user. returns a list of organizations with details including identifier, name, user role, trial status, and configuration settings. use the 'identifier' field from the response when calling other organization-related endpoints. #### output | parameter | type | required | description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | yes | data from the action execution | | `error` | string | no | error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | yes | whether or not the action execution was successful or not | read

organizations.updateorganization affinda.api.organizations.updateorganization tool to update specific fields of an organization. use when you need to modify an organization's name, avatar, or webhook and validation settings after creation. write

resthooks.createresthooksubscription affinda.api.resthooks.createresthooksubscription tool to create a new resthook subscription. use after confirming your webhook endpoint is ready to receive document event notifications. write

resthooks.deleteresthooksubscription affinda.api.resthooks.deleteresthooksubscription tool to delete a specific resthook subscription by id. use after confirming the subscription identifier when the webhook is no longer needed. destructive

resthooks.getresthooksubscription affinda.api.resthooks.getresthooksubscription tool to retrieve details of a specific resthook subscription by its id. use after confirming its creation to verify its settings. read

resthooks.getresthooksubscriptions affinda.api.resthooks.getresthooksubscriptions tool to retrieve a list of all resthook subscriptions. use after authenticating to list all webhook subscriptions associated with your account. read

resthooks.updateresthooksubscription affinda.api.resthooks.updateresthooksubscription tool to update an existing resthook subscription. use after confirming the subscription identifier to modify its url, event, or activation status. write

resumesearch.createresumesearch affinda.api.resumesearch.createresumesearch tool to search through parsed resumes using three methods: match to a job description, match to a resume, or custom criteria. use when you need to find candidates matching specific requirements. write

resumesearch.createresumesearchembedurl affinda.api.resumesearch.createresumesearchembedurl tool to create and return a signed url for the embeddable resume search tool. use this when you need to generate a url that can be embedded on a web page to provide resume search functionality. optionally pass config_override to customize display settings, field weights, and theme. write

resumesearch.listresumesearchconfig affinda.api.resumesearch.listresumesearchconfig tool to get the configuration for the logged in user's embeddable resume search tool. use this to retrieve display field settings, search weights, maximum results, and theme customization options for the resume search interface. #### output | parameter | type | required | description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | yes | data from the action execution | | `error` | string | no | error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | yes | whether or not the action execution was successful or not | read

resumesearch.listresumesearchjobtitlesuggestions affinda.api.resumesearch.listresumesearchjobtitlesuggestions tool to get job title suggestions based on provided job title(s). use when you need to find related job titles for resume search. read

resumesearch.listresumesearchskillsuggestions affinda.api.resumesearch.listresumesearchskillsuggestions tool to get skill suggestions based on provided skills. use when you need to find related skills to expand or refine resume search queries. read

resumesearch.updateresumesearchconfig affinda.api.resumesearch.updateresumesearchconfig tool to update the configuration for the logged in user's embeddable resume search tool. use this to modify which fields are displayed, their search weights, maximum results limit, distance units, custom actions, and theme settings. write

tags.createtag affinda.api.tags.createtag creates a new tag in the specified workspace. tags can be used to categorize and label documents for organization and filtering. each tag name must be unique within its workspace. returns the created tag with its id and metadata. write

tags.deletetag affinda.api.tags.deletetag permanently delete a tag from affinda by its id. this is a destructive operation that cannot be undone. use get tags first to verify the tag id before deletion. destructive
tags.getalltags affinda.api.tags.getalltags tool to list all tags. use after confirming authentication to fetch tags across workspaces. read
tags.gettag affinda.api.tags.gettag tool to retrieve details of a specific tag by its id. use when you need to fetch information about a particular tag. read

tags.updatetag affinda.api.tags.updatetag tool to update data of a tag. use when you need to modify a tag's name or reassign it to a different workspace. only provide the fields you want to change; other fields will remain unchanged. write

validation.splitdocumentpages affinda.api.validation.splitdocumentpages split a document into multiple documents by dividing its pages. use when you need to separate a multi-page document into distinct documents based on page groupings. prerequisites: - obtain the document identifier from create_document or get_document actions - use get_document to retrieve page ids for the pages you want to split important notes: - each page can only be assigned to one split - all pages should be accounted for across all splits - one split can optionally use the original document identifier to maintain the root document write

validationresults.createvalidationresult affinda.api.validationresults.createvalidationresult create a validation result for document annotations in affinda. use this tool to record validation outcomes after parsing a document. validation results track whether specific annotations (extracted data fields) pass or fail business rules. prerequisites: 1. get a document identifier from get documents or create document 2. get annotation ids from get annotations for that document 3. define a kebab-case rule slug that identifies your validation rule example use cases: - recording that an invoice total matches the sum of line items - marking that a required field is present and valid - logging validation failures for review workflows write

validationresults.createvalidationresultsbatch affinda.api.validationresults.createvalidationresultsbatch batch create multiple validation results for document annotations in a single api call. use this action to efficiently record validation outcomes for multiple documents or rules at once, rather than making individual create requests for each validation result. this is particularly useful for bulk validation workflows or when validating multiple rules across many documents. prerequisites: - obtain document identifiers from get documents or create document actions - get annotation ids from get annotations for those documents - define kebab-case rule slugs that identify your validation rules common use cases: - bulk recording of validation results across multiple documents - validating multiple business rules on the same document - automated validation workflows for large document batches write

validationresults.deletevalidationresults affinda.api.validationresults.deletevalidationresults delete multiple validation results in a single api call. use this action to efficiently remove multiple validation results at once rather than making individual delete requests for each validation result. prerequisites: - obtain validation result ids using the 'get all validation results' action common use cases: - removing obsolete validation results in bulk - cleaning up validation results after reprocessing documents - deleting validation results for specific documents programmatically destructive

validationresults.getallvalidationresults affinda.api.validationresults.getallvalidationresults tool to list validation results for documents. use after processing documents to inspect validation outcomes. read

workspacememberships.createworkspacemembership affinda.api.workspacememberships.createworkspacemembership tool to add a user to a workspace by creating a membership. use when you need to grant a user access to a specific workspace. write

workspacememberships.deleteworkspacemembership affinda.api.workspacememberships.deleteworkspacemembership tool to remove a user from a workspace by membership id. use after confirming the workspace membership id to revoke access. destructive

workspacememberships.getallworkspacememberships affinda.api.workspacememberships.getallworkspacememberships retrieve all workspace memberships across the account. returns paginated results showing which users belong to which workspaces. use to audit workspace access or find specific user memberships. read

workspacememberships.getworkspacemembership affinda.api.workspacememberships.getworkspacemembership tool to retrieve details of a specific workspace membership by its id. use when you need to confirm a user's role and details within a workspace after obtaining the membership identifier. read
workspaces.createworkspace affinda.api.workspaces.createworkspace tool to create a new workspace. use when you need to programmatically create a workspace container within an organization. write

workspaces.deleteworkspace affinda.api.workspaces.deleteworkspace tool to delete a specific workspace by its id. use when you need to remove an unused workspace after confirming the workspace id. destructive

workspaces.getusagebyworkspace affinda.api.workspaces.getusagebyworkspace retrieves monthly document processing usage statistics for a specific workspace. returns a list of usage records showing how many documents were processed each month. use this to track workspace activity, monitor consumption trends, or generate usage reports. read
workspaces.getworkspace affinda.api.workspaces.getworkspace tool to retrieve details of a specific workspace by its id. use when you need full workspace metadata after confirming its identifier. read
workspaces.getworkspaces affinda.api.workspaces.getworkspaces tool to retrieve a list of all workspaces. use when you need to list workspaces filtered by organization and optional name. read

workspaces.updateworkspace affinda.api.workspaces.updateworkspace tool to update specific fields of a workspace. use when you need to modify a workspace's name, visibility, document rejection policy, or other settings. only provide the fields you want to change; other fields will remain unchanged. write

leads.updatebusinesslead agencyzoom.api.leads.updatebusinesslead updates an existing business lead in agencyzoom. requires leadid (path parameter) plus core business information fields: firstname, email, name (business name), pipelineid, stageid, leadsourceid, assignto (producer id), and country. all other fields are optional and will only update if provided. write
leads.updatelead agencyzoom.api.leads.updatelead updates an existing lead's information in agencyzoom using the `leadid`; ensure the `leadid` corresponds to an existing lead in agencyzoom. write

leads.updateleadstatusbyid agencyzoom.api.leads.updateleadstatusbyid updates a lead's status (0=active, 2=won, 3=lost, 5=xdated) by `leadid`, optionally setting workflow, stage, date, loss reason, x-date type, source, recycle stage/pipeline, or tags; requires `date` and `xdatetype` for status 5 (xdated), and `lossreasonid` for status 3 (lost). write

life.searchlifeandhealthleads agencyzoom.api.life.searchlifeandhealthleads searches for life and health insurance leads by providing filter criteria (matching alrlead fields) in the request body; an empty request may retrieve all leads or a default set. #### output | parameter | type | required | description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | yes | data from the action execution | | `error` | string | no | error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | yes | whether or not the action execution was successful or not | read

opportunities.createadriverforanopportunity agencyzoom.api.opportunities.createadriverforanopportunity creates a new driver record associated with an existing agencyzoom opportunity using its id; requires firstname and lastname, with optional fields for additional driver details. write
opportunities.createanopportunity agencyzoom.api.opportunities.createanopportunity creates a new lead opportunity in agencyzoom; this action cannot update existing opportunities. write

opportunities.createavehicleforanopportunity agencyzoom.api.opportunities.createavehicleforanopportunity adds a new vehicle record to a specified opportunity; `opportunityid` must refer to a valid, existing opportunity. write

opportunities.deleteadriver agencyzoom.api.opportunities.deleteadriver permanently deletes an existing driver record (a person associated with an insurance opportunity) from agencyzoom using its unique `driverid`; this action is irreversible. destructive

opportunities.deleteanopportunity agencyzoom.api.opportunities.deleteanopportunity permanently deletes a specific opportunity by its unique id; this action is irreversible and requires a valid, existing `opportunityid`. destructive

opportunities.deleteavehicle agencyzoom.api.opportunities.deleteavehicle permanently deletes a vehicle record by its `vehicleid`, which must correspond to an existing vehicle in the agencyzoom system. destructive

opportunities.getalistofdriversforanopportunity agencyzoom.api.opportunities.getalistofdriversforanopportunity retrieves a list of drivers (individuals), including their personal details, licensing information, and relationship status, associated with a specific, existing `opportunityid` in agencyzoom. read

opportunities.getalistofvehiclesforanopportunity agencyzoom.api.opportunities.getalistofvehiclesforanopportunity retrieves all vehicles associated with an existing opportunity, using its unique opportunityid. read

opportunities.getthedriverdetails agencyzoom.api.opportunities.getthedriverdetails retrieves detailed information for a specific, existing driver (by `driverid`) associated with an agencyzoom opportunity. read
opportunities.gettheopportunitydetails agencyzoom.api.opportunities.gettheopportunitydetails fetches comprehensive details for an existing opportunity using its unique `opportunityid`. read

opportunities.getthevehicledetails agencyzoom.api.opportunities.getthevehicledetails retrieves detailed information for a specific vehicle, often associated with an agencyzoom opportunity, using its unique vehicleid. read
opportunities.linkadrivertoopportunity agencyzoom.api.opportunities.linkadrivertoopportunity assigns or reassigns an existing driver to an existing opportunity. write

opportunities.linkavehicletoopportunity agencyzoom.api.opportunities.linkavehicletoopportunity links an existing vehicle to an existing sales opportunity in agencyzoom using their respective ids, typically for managing auto insurance policies or related services. write

opportunities.unlinkadriverfromopportunity agencyzoom.api.opportunities.unlinkadriverfromopportunity unlinks a currently associated driver from an agencyzoom opportunity, used when the driver is no longer relevant, for policy or data updates, potentially impacting the opportunity's status or associated policy details. write

opportunities.unlinkavehiclefromopportunity agencyzoom.api.opportunities.unlinkavehiclefromopportunity unlinks a specific, existing vehicle from a specific, existing opportunity using their respective ids, removing only the association and not the records themselves. write

opportunities.updateadriversdetails agencyzoom.api.opportunities.updateadriversdetails updates an existing driver's details in agencyzoom, requiring `driverid` in the path and `firstname` and `lastname` in the request. write

opportunities.updateanopportunity agencyzoom.api.opportunities.updateanopportunity updates an existing opportunity with the provided details; ensure any custom field names are predefined in agencyzoom configuration. write

opportunities.updateavehiclesdetails agencyzoom.api.opportunities.updateavehiclesdetails updates details for an existing vehicle within an opportunity; this action cannot be used to create new vehicle records. write
policies.updateapolicy agencyzoom.api.policies.updateapolicy updates an existing insurance policy for the given `policyid`; monetary values must be in cents and dates in yyyy-mm-dd format. write

policies.updatetagsforapolicy agencyzoom.api.policies.updatetagsforapolicy adds new comma-separated `tagnames` to a policy, requiring `tagnames` and identification by either `policyid` or `amspolicyid`; if `amspolicyid` is provided, `policyid` is ignored, and existing tags are not affected. write

profile.updatemyprofile agencyzoom.api.profile.updatemyprofile updates the profile information (first name, last name, email, and optional phone) for the currently authenticated user in agencyzoom; the provided email address must be unique within the system. write

referencedata.getalistofassigngroups agencyzoom.api.referencedata.getalistofassigngroups retrieves all assign groups configured in agencyzoom, used for categorizing or assigning items to specific teams or units. #### output | parameter | type | required | description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | yes | data from the action execution | | `error` | string | no | error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | yes | whether or not the action execution was successful or not | read

referencedata.getalistofcarriers agencyzoom.api.referencedata.getalistofcarriers retrieves all insurance carriers from agencyzoom, typically used for populating selection lists or synchronizing carrier data; does not return detailed policy or coverage information. #### output | parameter | type | required | description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | yes | data from the action execution | | `error` | string | no | error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | yes | whether or not the action execution was successful or not | read

referencedata.getalistofcsrs agencyzoom.api.referencedata.getalistofcsrs fetches all customer service representatives (csrs), including their id and name, returning an empty list if none are configured. #### output | parameter | type | required | description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | yes | data from the action execution | | `error` | string | no | error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | yes | whether or not the action execution was successful or not | read

referencedata.getalistofcustomfields agencyzoom.api.referencedata.getalistofcustomfields retrieves metadata for all configured custom field definitions, not the specific values entered for individual records. #### output | parameter | type | required | description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | yes | data from the action execution | | `error` | string | no | error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | yes | whether or not the action execution was successful or not | read

referencedata.getalistofemployees agencyzoom.api.referencedata.getalistofemployees retrieves a complete list of all employees for the authenticated agency; returns an empty list if no employees are configured. #### output | parameter | type | required | description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | yes | data from the action execution | | `error` | string | no | error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | yes | whether or not the action execution was successful or not | read

referencedata.getalistofleadsourcecategories agencyzoom.api.referencedata.getalistofleadsourcecategories retrieves a comprehensive list of all predefined lead source categories from agencyzoom, used to classify lead origins. #### output | parameter | type | required | description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | yes | data from the action execution | | `error` | string | no | error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | yes | whether or not the action execution was successful or not | read

referencedata.getalistofleadsources agencyzoom.api.referencedata.getalistofleadsources fetches a list of all lead sources configured in agencyzoom, including their id, name, sales exclusion status, and category id. #### output | parameter | type | required | description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | yes | data from the action execution | | `error` | string | no | error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | yes | whether or not the action execution was successful or not | read

referencedata.getalistoflifeprofessionals agencyzoom.api.referencedata.getalistoflifeprofessionals retrieves a list of life insurance professionals, including only their contact and status information (excluding sales or customer data), from the agencyzoom platform. #### output | parameter | type | required | description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | yes | data from the action execution | | `error` | string | no | error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | yes | whether or not the action execution was successful or not | read

referencedata.getalistoflocations agencyzoom.api.referencedata.getalistoflocations retrieves all agency locations or branches from agencyzoom; filtering options are not available. #### output | parameter | type | required | description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | yes | data from the action execution | | `error` | string | no | error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | yes | whether or not the action execution was successful or not | read

referencedata.getalistoflossreasons agencyzoom.api.referencedata.getalistoflossreasons retrieves all predefined loss reasons (e.g., 'lost to competitor', 'premium too high') available in agencyzoom. these reasons can be used when marking leads as lost or for reporting purposes. no parameters required - returns complete list. #### output | parameter | type | required | description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | yes | data from the action execution | | `error` | string | no | error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | yes | whether or not the action execution was successful or not | read

referencedata.getalistofpipelines agencyzoom.api.referencedata.getalistofpipelines retrieves all pipelines and their stages from agencyzoom to understand workflow structures; this is a read-only operation and does not return individual items (like leads or tasks) within these pipelines. #### output | parameter | type | required | description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | yes | data from the action execution | | `error` | string | no | error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | yes | whether or not the action execution was successful or not | read

referencedata.getalistofproductlinespolicytypes agencyzoom.api.referencedata.getalistofproductlinespolicytypes fetches all product lines and policy types from agencyzoom, each detailed with its id, name, and product category id. #### output | parameter | type | required | description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | yes | data from the action execution | | `error` | string | no | error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | yes | whether or not the action execution was successful or not | read

referencedata.getalistofrecycleevents agencyzoom.api.referencedata.getalistofrecycleevents retrieves the available recycle event types and any existing x-date information for a specified lead in agencyzoom. returns a list of recycle event categories that can be used to trigger follow-ups (e.g., 'x-date', 'accident falls off', 'prior insurance fulfilled'). read

referencedata.getdepartmentsgroups agencyzoom.api.referencedata.getdepartmentsgroups fetches department and group information for an agency, optionally filtered by a specific `agencynumber`, to analyze its organizational structure. read

referencedata.getlistofendstages agencyzoom.api.referencedata.getlistofendstages fetches a list of all defined end stages, representing final steps in processes like lead conversion or policy closure. #### output | parameter | type | required | description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | yes | data from the action execution | | `error` | string | no | error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | yes | whether or not the action execution was successful or not | read

referencedata.listproductcategories agencyzoom.api.referencedata.listproductcategories retrieves a complete, unfiltered list of all product categories (id and name) from agencyzoom, useful for understanding product organization or populating ui elements. #### output | parameter | type | required | description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | yes | data from the action execution | | `error` | string | no | error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | yes | whether or not the action execution was successful or not | read

referencedata.searchbusinessclassifications agencyzoom.api.referencedata.searchbusinessclassifications retrieves a comprehensive list of all available business classifications from agencyzoom, each including an id, code, and description. #### output | parameter | type | required | description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | yes | data from the action execution | | `error` | string | no | error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | yes | whether or not the action execution was successful or not | read

servicetickets.serviceticketlist agencyzoom.api.servicetickets.serviceticketlist retrieves a paginated list of service tickets from agencyzoom. supports filtering by: - status (0=removed, 1=active, 2=completed) - priority id and category id returns service ticket details including subject, description, dates, assignment information, and workflow stage. results are paginated with default page size of 20 tickets per page. read

tasks.batchdeletetask agencyzoom.api.tasks.batchdeletetask deletes multiple agencyzoom tasks in a batch; task deletion is permanent and the response indicates overall batch success, not individual task status. destructive
tasks.completetask agencyzoom.api.tasks.completetask marks an existing and accessible task in agencyzoom as 'completed'; this action does not return the full updated task object. write

tasks.createtask agencyzoom.api.tasks.createtask creates a new task in agencyzoom; ensure `assigneeid`, `customerid`, or `leadid` are valid existing entities if provided, and use `contactemail`, `customerid`, or `leadid` to link the task to a contact. write
tasks.deleteatask agencyzoom.api.tasks.deleteatask permanently and irreversibly deletes an existing task, identified by its `taskid`. destructive

tasks.getthetaskdetails agencyzoom.api.tasks.getthetaskdetails retrieves comprehensive details for a specific task using its unique `taskid`, which must correspond to an existing task in agencyzoom. read
tasks.reopenatask agencyzoom.api.tasks.reopenatask reopens an existing agencyzoom task that is currently 'completed' or 'closed', allowing it to be reactivated with optional comments. write
tasks.searchtasks agencyzoom.api.tasks.searchtasks searches and lists tasks, supporting pagination and accepting filter criteria in the post request body despite an empty request schema. read

tasks.updatetask agencyzoom.api.tasks.updatetask modifies an existing agencyzoom task (which must be valid and identified by `taskid` in the path) with new attributes from the request body, which must also contain `taskid`. write

textthreads.getalistofproducer agencyzoom.api.textthreads.getalistofproducer retrieves a list of all producers from agencyzoom, typically related to text thread functionalities. #### output | parameter | type | required | description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | yes | data from the action execution | | `error` | string | no | error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | yes | whether or not the action execution was successful or not | read

textthreads.removetextthreadendpoint agencyzoom.api.textthreads.removetextthreadendpoint call this action to permanently delete an sms/text message thread in agencyzoom; the target thread is identified by its `threadid`. note: this operation is idempotent - deleting a non-existent thread will return success. destructive

textthreads.searchsmsthreads agencyzoom.api.textthreads.searchsmsthreads searches and retrieves sms threads from agencyzoom, with search parameters, filters, sorting, and pagination typically provided in the request body of this post operation. #### output | parameter | type | required | description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | yes | data from the action execution | | `error` | string | no | error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | yes | whether or not the action execution was successful or not | read

textthreads.textdetailthread agencyzoom.api.textthreads.textdetailthread retrieves detailed messages for a specific sms/text thread by its thread id. returns all messages in the thread with their content, attachments, sender/recipient information, and metadata. the thread id can be obtained from the search_sms_threads action. read
textthreads.unreadthread agencyzoom.api.textthreads.unreadthread updates the read or unread status of a specific sms/text thread within agencyzoom. write

v4sso.authenticateforjwtviav4sso agencyzoom.api.v4sso.authenticateforjwtviav4sso completes agencyzoom v4 single sign-on (sso) authentication by exchanging an oauth2 authorization code for a jwt token. prerequisites: first call get_auth_url_for_v4sso to obtain the authentication url, then redirect the user to that url for login. after successful authentication through vertafore's oauth provider, the callback will include a 'code' parameter. use that code with this action to obtain the jwt token for api access. note: this is typically used during initial authentication setup. the code is single-use, time-limited, and must match the pkce challenge from the original auth request. write

v4sso.getauthurlforv4sso agencyzoom.api.v4sso.getauthurlforv4sso retrieves a fresh authentication url for agencyzoom's v4 single sign-on (sso) process; call before each sso attempt as the url may change and should not be cached. #### output | parameter | type | required | description | |-----------|------|----------|-------------| | `data` | string | yes | data from the action execution | | `error` | string | no | error if any occurred during the execution of the action | | `successful` | boolean | yes | whether or not the action execution was successful or not | write
messages.get agentmail.api.messages.get retrieve the complete details of an agentmail message read
messages.list agentmail.api.messages.list list messages from an agentmail inbox read
messages.send agentmail.api.messages.send send an email using agentmail write
message.received agentmail.webhooks.message.received a new email was received in an agentmail inbox

browsersessions.createremotebrowsersession agentql.api.browsersessions.createremotebrowsersession tool to create a remote browser session. use when you need to run browser automation on remote infrastructure. write

data.query agentql.api.data.query tool to query structured data as json from a web page using an agentql query or natural language prompt. use after defining your query or prompt and a url or html. read

data.querydocument agentql.api.data.querydocument tool to extract structured data from pdf or image documents using an agentql query or natural language prompt. accepts a file plus query or prompt. takes the file as a public link, base64 or a blob; on corsair, pass a files id. read

usage.get agentql.api.usage.get retrieves api usage statistics and subscription limits for the agentql account. returns current billing cycle dates, lifetime usage limits, api key usage counts, and total account usage. useful for monitoring quota consumption and planning usage. no parameters required - uses the authenticated api key from connection settings. read

agents.agentscontrollercreateagent agenty.api.agents.agentscontrollercreateagent creates a new agenty agent for web scraping, change detection, crawling, map monitoring, or brand monitoring. use this tool to set up automated data extraction agents. requires: - name: a descriptive name for the agent - type: one of 'scraping', 'changedetection', 'crawling', 'mapmonitoring', 'brandmonitoring' - config: configuration object with url, browser, and collections defining what data to extract the config.collections array contains field definitions with css selectors or other extraction methods. each field specifies what data to extract and how (text content, attr for attributes, etc.). optional: set start=true to immediately run the agent after creation, or configure a scheduler for recurring runs. returns the created agent with its unique agent_id for future reference. write

agents.agentscontrollergettemplates agenty.api.agents.agentscontrollergettemplates tool to fetch all public agent templates and sample agents. use when listing available templates for users to select. read
agents.agentsdeletebyid agenty.api.agents.agentsdeletebyid tool to delete a single agent by its id. use when you need to permanently remove an agent after confirming it exists. destructive
agents.agentsgetall agenty.api.agents.agentsgetall tool to fetch all active agents under an account. use after authenticating when you need to list agents with pagination and sorting. read

agents.agentsgetbyid agenty.api.agents.agentsgetbyid retrieves complete details of a specific agent including its configuration, input settings, scheduler, and metadata. use this tool when you need to: - view full agent configuration and settings - check agent type and current version - access scheduler and script configurations - verify agent status before executing jobs - retrieve agent metadata for updates or cloning read

agents.agentsupdatebyid agenty.api.agents.agentsupdatebyid updates an existing agent's configuration, settings, and metadata. use this tool to modify an agent's properties such as name, type, config, tags, scheduler, scripts, or visibility settings. the api only returns the fields that were updated in the response, not the complete agent object. to get the full updated agent details, use the 'get agent by id' action after updating. example uses: - "update agent abc123 to change its name to 'production scraper'" - "enable scheduling for agent xyz789 with a cron expression '0 */6 * * *'" - "update agent def456 config to scrape a different url" write

agents.copyagent agenty.api.agents.copyagent tool to copy an existing agent by its id, creating a duplicate with optionally a new name. use when you need to duplicate an agent's configuration to create a similar agent without starting from scratch. write

agents.transferagentownership agenty.api.agents.transferagentownership tool to transfer agent ownership to another agenty account. use when you need to move an agent to a different user's account by specifying their email address. write

apikeys.apikeyscontrollercreateapikeys agenty.api.apikeys.apikeyscontrollercreateapikeys creates a new api key for programmatic access to the agenty api. the generated api key can be used to authenticate api requests with different permission levels (owner, admin, or manager). the key is returned in the response and should be securely stored as it provides access to your agenty account. write

apikeys.apikeysdeletebyid agenty.api.apikeys.apikeysdeletebyid delete an api key by its unique identifier. use this tool to permanently revoke access for a specific api key. the key_id can be obtained from the "get all api keys" or "create api key" actions. this action cannot be undone. destructive
apikeys.apikeysdownload agenty.api.apikeys.apikeysdownload tool to download all api keys under an account in csv format. use when you need a complete list of api keys for export or backup. read
apikeys.apikeysgetall agenty.api.apikeys.apikeysgetall tool to retrieve all api keys under an account. use after authentication when you need to list api keys with pagination and sorting. read

apikeys.apikeysgetbyid agenty.api.apikeys.apikeysgetbyid retrieves detailed information about a specific api key by its id. use this action when you need to: - get the full details of an api key including its value, role, and status - verify the existence and properties of a specific api key - check if an api key is enabled or disabled the key_id can be obtained from the 'get all api keys' action or when creating a new api key. read

apikeys.apikeysresetbyid agenty.api.apikeys.apikeysresetbyid resets (regenerates) the secret value of an existing api key. the old secret becomes invalid immediately. important: this action only confirms the reset was successful but does not return the new secret. after resetting, use the 'get api key by id' action to retrieve the new secret value. use this when you need to: - rotate api key secrets for security - invalidate a compromised api key and generate a new secret - update credentials as part of security maintenance destructive

apikeys.apikeysupdatebyid agenty.api.apikeys.apikeysupdatebyid updates an existing api key's name and role by its unique identifier. this action allows you to modify the display name and permission level of an api key. only the name and role fields can be updated; other properties are read-only. after updating, the action automatically fetches and returns the complete updated api key details. use this when you need to: - rename an api key for better identification - change the permission level (owner, admin, or manager) of an api key - update multiple properties of an api key at once write

apikeys.changeapikeystatusbyid agenty.api.apikeys.changeapikeystatusbyid toggles the enabled/disabled status of an api key. this endpoint switches the key between enabled and disabled states - if the key is currently enabled, it will be disabled, and vice versa. returns a confirmation message upon successful status change. use this after retrieving the key_id from the list or get api key endpoints. write

browser.capturescreenshot agenty.api.browser.capturescreenshot tool to capture a full-page or visible screenshot of any webpage url. use when you need to capture visual representation of a webpage as an image file. the screenshot is captured using browser automation with default settings. read

browser.capturescreenshotwithoptions agenty.api.browser.capturescreenshotwithoptions tool to capture webpage screenshots with extensive customization options including full-page capture, image format, quality settings, viewport configuration, and post-processing. use when you need to take screenshots of web pages with specific requirements for size, format, or rendering behavior. write

browser.converturltopdf agenty.api.browser.converturltopdf tool to convert a webpage url to a pdf document. use when you need to generate a pdf file from a web page for archival, reporting, or offline viewing purposes. read

browser.converturltopdfwithoptions agenty.api.browser.converturltopdfwithoptions tool to convert a url or raw html to pdf with customizable options. use when you need to generate pdfs with specific formatting requirements like custom page sizes, margins, headers/footers, or orientation. supports both url-based and html content conversion. write

browser.extractbrowserstructureddata agenty.api.browser.extractbrowserstructureddata tool to auto-extract structured data from a webpage including schema.org, rdfa, microdata, and json-ld formats. use when you need to automatically extract semantic markup from web pages without writing custom scraping rules. the api returns organized structured data in four categories: metatags, microdata, rdfa, and jsonld. write

browser.extractstructureddata agenty.api.browser.extractstructureddata tool to auto-extract structured data from a webpage url. use when you need to extract schema.org, rdfa, microdata, or json-ld structured data from web pages. read

browser.getbrowserredirects agenty.api.browser.getbrowserredirects tool to get the complete redirect chain for a url. use when you need to trace how a url redirects, including both server-side (http 3xx redirects) and client-side redirects (javascript, meta tags). returns an ordered list of all redirect steps from the original url to the final destination. read

browser.getpagecontent agenty.api.browser.getpagecontent tool to fetch the complete html content of any webpage url. use this when you need to retrieve the full html source code of a page, including content rendered after javascript execution. the api navigates to the url using proxies and captures the page's source content. read

browser.getpagecontentwithoptions agenty.api.browser.getpagecontentwithoptions tool to fetch html content of a webpage with custom options including ad blocking. use this when you need to retrieve the full html source of a webpage, particularly for web scraping or content analysis tasks. the tool supports ad blocking to speed up page loads and reduce unnecessary content. write

browser.getredirectswithoptions agenty.api.browser.getredirectswithoptions tool to get the complete redirect chain of a url with custom navigation options. use when you need to trace url redirects including both server-side (3xx) and client-side redirects (javascript, meta tags). supports custom timeout and navigation wait conditions to ensure all redirects are captured. write

browser.scrapewebpagedata agenty.api.browser.scrapewebpagedata tool to scrape data from any webpage using jquery/css selectors. use when you need to extract specific data from web pages by defining jquery selector expressions. each query field maps a name to a jquery expression (e.g., "$('h1').text()" extracts the h1 text). the browser will load the page, execute javascript, and run your jquery queries to extract the data. write

connections.connectionsgetall agenty.api.connections.connectionsgetall retrieves all connections from your agenty account. supports pagination via limit/offset and sorting by field name. returns an empty list if no connections exist. read

dashboard.dashboardgetreportsusage agenty.api.dashboard.dashboardgetreportsusage tool to fetch account reports like pages used by agent, date, and product. use when analyzing usage over a date range. read

inputs.inputsgetbyagentid agenty.api.inputs.inputsgetbyagentid retrieves the input configuration for a specific agent by its id. returns the input source type (url, manual list, saved list reference, or another agent's output) and associated configuration details. use this to inspect an agent's current input setup before modifying it or starting a job, or to verify what data sources an agent will process. read

inputs.inputsupdatebyagentid agenty.api.inputs.inputsupdatebyagentid updates the input configuration for a specific agent in agenty. this tool modifies where an agent gets its input data from. you can configure the agent to: - pull from a url feed (type='url') - use a manually specified list of urls (type='manual') - reference data from an agenty list (type='list') - use output from another agent (type='agent') use this after creating or identifying an agent to set up its data source before running jobs. write

jobs.downloadagentresult agenty.api.jobs.downloadagentresult tool to download agent results by agent id in csv, tsv or json format. use when you need to export or analyze agent execution results as a file. read

jobs.getagentresult agenty.api.jobs.getagentresult tool to get the most recent result data for an agent. use when you need to retrieve and view the scraped/collected data from an agent's latest execution. returns result data with pagination support. read

jobs.getjobresult agenty.api.jobs.getjobresult tool to get the result data from a completed job. use when you need to retrieve and view the scraped/collected data from a finished job. returns result data with pagination support. read
jobs.jobsdownload agenty.api.jobs.jobsdownload tool to download all jobs in csv format. use when you need a complete list of jobs for export or analysis. read
jobs.jobsdownloadfilesbyid agenty.api.jobs.jobsdownloadfilesbyid tool to download output files by job id. use when you need to fetch a specific output file after a job completes. read

weather.getforecast ambee.api.weather.getforecast get the hourly weather forecast for a latitude/longitude (next 72 hours) read
weather.gethistory ambee.api.weather.gethistory get hourly historical weather for a latitude/longitude over a time range read
weather.getlatest ambee.api.weather.getlatest get current weather conditions (temperature, humidity, wind, uv) for a latitude/longitude read
devices.getdata ambientweather.api.devices.getdata fetch historical weather data for a specific ambient weather device read
devices.list ambientweather.api.devices.list list all ambient weather devices for the connected account with their latest readings read
cards.list amcards.api.cards.list list cards for the authenticated account read
categories.get amcards.api.categories.get get a card template category by id read
categories.list amcards.api.categories.list list card template categories ordered by priority read
contacts.list amcards.api.contacts.list list contacts, optionally filtered by name or email read
gifts.get amcards.api.gifts.get get a gift by id read
gifts.list amcards.api.gifts.list list available gifts read
schema.getapi amcards.api.schema.getapi retrieve the amcards api v1 schema (resource map) read
schema.getcategory amcards.api.schema.getcategory retrieve the readonly category resource schema read
templates.get amcards.api.templates.get get a public card template by id read
templates.list amcards.api.templates.list list public card templates read
agentcredentials.claude.check amika.api.agentcredentials.claude.check checks that a stored claude code credential can still authenticate. read
agentcredentials.claude.create amika.api.agentcredentials.claude.create stores a claude code credential (type oauth or api_key) that rigs can be given. write
agentcredentials.claude.delete amika.api.agentcredentials.claude.delete deletes a stored claude code credential. destructive
agentcredentials.claude.list amika.api.agentcredentials.claude.list lists stored claude code credentials (oauth tokens or api keys) by name and scope, never values. read
agentcredentials.codex.create amika.api.agentcredentials.codex.create stores a codex credential (type oauth or api_key) that rigs can be given. write
agentcredentials.codex.delete amika.api.agentcredentials.codex.delete deletes a stored codex credential. destructive
agentcredentials.codex.list amika.api.agentcredentials.codex.list lists stored codex credentials by name and scope, never values. read
agentcredentials.pi.delete amika.api.agentcredentials.pi.delete deletes the pi agent credential. destructive
agentcredentials.pi.get amika.api.agentcredentials.pi.get reads whether a pi agent credential is configured. read
agentcredentials.pi.set amika.api.agentcredentials.pi.set saves the pi agent credential. write
agentsessions.get amika.api.agentsessions.get reads one agent session: its rig, agent, status and the messages exchanged so far. read
agentsessions.list amika.api.agentsessions.list lists the organization's agent-session chats, newest first, with each one's rig, agent, model and a preview. read

agentsessions.send amika.api.agentsessions.send sends one message to a coding agent (claude code or codex) in a rig and waits for its reply. without sandbox_id/sandbox_name/sandbox_ref it creates a new rig from repo_url; pass session_id to continue a chat. a failed turn still answers 200 with is_error: true and the agent cli's own message. runs on the rig's stored agent credential and can take minutes. destructive
apikeys.create amika.api.apikeys.create creates an amika api key (user or organization scope). the value is returned once. write
apikeys.delete amika.api.apikeys.delete deletes an amika api key; anything using it stops working. scope defaults to organization: pass scope user to delete a user key. destructive
apikeys.list amika.api.apikeys.list lists the caller's amika api keys (names, scopes, last use; values obfuscated). read
cloudaccounts.create amika.api.cloudaccounts.create connects a cloud provider account with its api key, so rigs can run there. write
cloudaccounts.delete amika.api.cloudaccounts.delete disconnects a cloud account and deletes its stored api key. destructive
cloudaccounts.get amika.api.cloudaccounts.get reads one connected cloud account by id or name. read
cloudaccounts.list amika.api.cloudaccounts.list lists the organization's connected cloud provider accounts that rigs can run in. read
cloudaccounts.listsizes amika.api.cloudaccounts.listsizes lists the rig sizes a cloud account offers. read
cloudaccounts.update amika.api.cloudaccounts.update updates a connected cloud account: its name or api key. write
commandruns.cancel amika.api.commandruns.cancel requests cancellation of a queued or running command run. write

commandruns.create amika.api.commandruns.create queues one shell command on a rig (run with bash -e -o pipefail) and answers at once. name an existing rig (rig_id, rig_name or rig_ref) or create one with rig_create; a stopped rig is started. poll commandruns.get for status and commandruns.listevents for output. an idempotencykey is made for you when you leave it out. destructive
commandruns.get amika.api.commandruns.get reads one command run: status (queued, in_progress, completed), conclusion (success, failure, timed_out...), exit code, timing and its rig. read
commandruns.list amika.api.commandruns.list lists command runs (queued shell commands on rigs), filtered by rig, status or session. read

commandruns.listevents amika.api.commandruns.listevents reads the output events of a command run after a sequence number: pass the next_sequence of the previous answer as after to read on from there. read
gitusersettings.get amika.api.gitusersettings.get reads the caller's git author name and email, which rigs use for commits. read
gitusersettings.set amika.api.gitusersettings.set sets the caller's git author name and email for commits made in rigs. write
hosts.checkhealth amika.api.hosts.checkhealth checks whether a host's daemon is answering. read
hosts.create amika.api.hosts.create registers a host for bring-your-own-compute. amika-hostd setup normally does this. write
hosts.delete amika.api.hosts.delete deletes a host and its stored secret; rigs can no longer be created on it. destructive
hosts.enrol amika.api.hosts.enrol enrols a tunnel host with its gateway. write
hosts.get amika.api.hosts.get reads one of your own hosts: its hostname, runtimes, sizes and status. read
hosts.list amika.api.hosts.list lists the organization's own hosts (machines running amika-hostd) and their runtimes and sizes. read
hosts.replace amika.api.hosts.replace replaces a host's registration: hostname, url and settings. write
integrations.disconnect amika.api.integrations.disconnect disconnects an integration provider for the caller and deletes its stored token. destructive
integrations.list amika.api.integrations.list lists the caller's connected integrations (github, sentry, linear, pylon). read
jobruns.cancel amika.api.jobruns.cancel cancels a pending or running job run. write
jobruns.get amika.api.jobruns.get reads one job run: status, timing and the command run of each step. read
jobruns.list amika.api.jobruns.list lists job runs, filtered by job, status or trigger kind. read
jobruns.start amika.api.jobruns.start starts a run of a job now, outside its schedule. destructive

jobs.create amika.api.jobs.create creates a job: a cron trigger and 1 to 20 shell steps. each time the trigger fires, a job run runs the steps in order on one rig. step 0 names the rig with exactly one of rig_id, rig_name, rig_ref or rig_create; later steps name none and run on step 0's rig. set enabled false to create it paused. an idempotencykey is made for you when you leave it out. destructive
jobs.delete amika.api.jobs.delete deletes a job and all of its job runs. destructive
jobs.get amika.api.jobs.get reads one job by id or name. read
jobs.list amika.api.jobs.list lists jobs (scheduled commands on rigs) with their trigger, steps and next run. read

jobs.update amika.api.jobs.update updates a job: its trigger, steps or description; enabled false pauses it and true resumes it. new steps follow the jobs.create rule: only step 0 names a rig. destructive
linear.settings.get amika.api.linear.settings.get reads the organization's linear defaults: repository, agent and system prompt. 404 when not set. read
linear.settings.set amika.api.linear.settings.set sets the organization's linear defaults: the repository and agent linear issues use. write
repositories.clearimage amika.api.repositories.clearimage clears a repository's image configuration, so new rigs use the preset image. destructive
repositories.get amika.api.repositories.get reads one repository and its rig settings. read
repositories.integrations.list amika.api.repositories.integrations.list lists the mcp integrations new rigs of a repository get. read
repositories.integrations.set amika.api.repositories.integrations.set replaces the list of mcp integrations new rigs of a repository get. write
repositories.list amika.api.repositories.list lists the organization's repositories and their rig settings (setup script, image, env). read
repositories.upsert amika.api.repositories.upsert creates or updates a repository by repo_url: its setup script, image and environment for new rigs. write

rigs.create amika.api.rigs.create creates a rig: a devbox vm with a repo cloned, dependencies set up and agent credentials injected. runs on amika cloud (billed per second), a connected cloud account, or one of your own hosts (host_id). answers 202 while it boots; poll rigs.get until status is running and setup_status ok (git-failed, setup-failed or sys-setup-failed means setup failed: stop waiting). by default the rig gets a new organization api key as amika_api_key (amika_api_key changes that). destructive

rigs.createsshsession amika.api.rigs.createsshsession opens a direct websocket ssh session to a rig and returns its connection details. name the rig by id or name; `sandbox_by` says which (default: either). write
rigs.createterminalticket amika.api.rigs.createterminalticket mints a single-use ticket for the web terminal of a rig. name the rig by id or name; `sandbox_by` says which (default: either). write

rigs.delete amika.api.rigs.delete deletes a rig and its disk. anything not pushed or snapshotted is lost. a bare-metal rig is your own machine: only the rig and its ssh bridge state go, and the files and settings on the machine stay. with forget "true", amika only drops its record when the host or provider can't be reached: the machine is left running, so confirm with the host or provider that it is gone. name the rig by id or name; `by` says which (default: either). destructive
rigs.get amika.api.rigs.get reads one rig: status, setup status, provider, size, branch, services and timestamps. name the rig by id or name; `by` says which (default: either). read
rigs.getslackconversation amika.api.rigs.getslackconversation reads the slack thread a slack-made rig belongs to. read
rigs.getslackmetadata amika.api.rigs.getslackmetadata lists slack metadata (team, channel, thread) for the organization's slack-made rigs, keyed by rig. read
rigs.list amika.api.rigs.list lists the organization's rigs (isolated devbox vms for coding agents) with their status, provider and size. read

rigs.listintegrations amika.api.rigs.listintegrations lists the mcp integrations (sentry, linear, pylon) attached to a rig at creation. name the rig by id or name; `sandbox_by` says which (default: either). read

rigs.listlifecycleevents amika.api.rigs.listlifecycleevents reads the control-plane event feed of a rig: created, setup steps, started, stopped, errors. name the rig by id or name; `sandbox_by` says which (default: either). read
rigs.services.create amika.api.rigs.services.create exposes a port of a rig as a named service with its own http or https url (a dev server preview). write
rigs.services.createtoken amika.api.rigs.services.createtoken mints an access token for a service of a rig that runs on your own host, for calling it from a script. write
rigs.services.delete amika.api.rigs.services.delete removes a live service from a rig; its url stops answering. destructive
rigs.services.list amika.api.rigs.services.list lists the live services of a rig: name, port and the url that reaches it. name the rig by id or name; `sandbox_by` says which (default: either). read
rigs.services.replace amika.api.rigs.services.replace replaces a live service on a rig: its name, port and url scheme. write

rigs.sessions.create amika.api.rigs.sessions.create creates a new, empty agent session on a rig for the named agent (no message is sent). name the rig by id or name; `sandbox_by` says which (default: either). write
rigs.sessions.get amika.api.rigs.sessions.get reads one agent session on a rig by its session id. read
rigs.sessions.getlatest amika.api.rigs.sessions.getlatest reads the most recent agent session on a rig. name the rig by id or name; `sandbox_by` says which (default: either). read
rigs.sessions.list amika.api.rigs.sessions.list lists the agent sessions on one rig. name the rig by id or name; `sandbox_by` says which (default: either). read
rigs.sessions.update amika.api.rigs.sessions.update updates an agent session on a rig: its status or metadata. write

rigs.start amika.api.rigs.start starts a stopped rig. on a vm rig, files in the home folder are kept and /tmp is cleared by the restart; on a bare-metal rig it only starts the ssh bridge again (the machine never stopped). billing resumes while it runs. name the rig by id or name; `by` says which (default: either). destructive

rigs.stop amika.api.rigs.stop stops a running rig so it stops billing for compute. on a vm rig, files in the home folder are kept and /tmp is cleared when it starts again, so keep work in the home folder. on a bare-metal rig only the ssh bridge stops: the machine keeps running and its files, /tmp included, stay as they are. name the rig by id or name; `by` says which (default: either). write
secrets.create amika.api.secrets.create stores a generic secret in the amika vault (user or organization scope) for injecting into rigs as an env var. write
secrets.delete amika.api.secrets.delete deletes a generic secret from the vault. destructive
secrets.list amika.api.secrets.list lists the generic secrets the caller can see (names and scopes, never values). read
secrets.sshpublickeys.delete amika.api.secrets.sshpublickeys.delete deletes one of the caller's ssh public keys. destructive
secrets.sshpublickeys.list amika.api.secrets.sshpublickeys.list lists the caller's ssh public keys. read
secrets.sshpublickeys.upsert amika.api.secrets.sshpublickeys.upsert adds or replaces one of the caller's ssh public keys, used for rig ssh and editor access. write
secrets.update amika.api.secrets.update updates a generic secret: its value, name or scope. write
servicedefinitions.create amika.api.servicedefinitions.create adds a service definition to a repository: a named set of ports every rig of that repository exposes. write
servicedefinitions.delete amika.api.servicedefinitions.delete deletes a service definition from a repository. destructive
servicedefinitions.update amika.api.servicedefinitions.update updates a repository's service definition: its name and ports. write
services.list amika.api.services.list lists the live services across the organization's rigs. read
slack.channelsettings.delete amika.api.slack.channelsettings.delete deletes one slack channel's defaults; it falls back to the workspace defaults. destructive
slack.channelsettings.list amika.api.slack.channelsettings.list lists per-channel slack defaults and the channels the amika bot has seen recently. read
slack.channelsettings.set amika.api.slack.channelsettings.set sets the repository, agent and system prompt one slack channel uses. write
slack.settings.get amika.api.slack.settings.get reads the organization's slack defaults: repository, agent and system prompt. 404 when not set. read
slack.settings.set amika.api.slack.settings.set sets the organization's slack defaults: the repository and agent a new slack thread uses, and an optional system prompt. write

snapshots.create amika.api.snapshots.create starts capturing a snapshot of a running rig (sandbox_ref names it). mode scrub_and_delete (default) removes injected secrets and deletes the source rig; full keeps both. answers 202; poll snapshots.get for status. destructive
snapshots.delete amika.api.snapshots.delete deletes a snapshot by name (default) or id. rigs can no longer boot from it. destructive
snapshots.get amika.api.snapshots.get reads one snapshot by name (default) or id: status, source rig and size. read
snapshots.list amika.api.snapshots.list lists snapshots captured from rigs (reusable base images new rigs can boot from). read
snapshots.previewscrub amika.api.snapshots.previewscrub previews which injected secrets a scrub_and_delete snapshot of a rig would remove. read
annotations.create amplitude.api.annotations.create create a new chart annotation on a specific date write
annotations.list amplitude.api.annotations.list list all chart annotations for the project read
charts.get amplitude.api.charts.get get the data results for a specific chart by id read
cohorts.create amplitude.api.cohorts.create create a new static cohort from a list of user or device ids write
cohorts.get amplitude.api.cohorts.get get details for a specific cohort by id read
cohorts.getmembers amplitude.api.cohorts.getmembers retrieve the member download for a cohort export request read
cohorts.list amplitude.api.cohorts.list list all cohorts in the project read
dashboards.get amplitude.api.dashboards.get get details and chart list for a specific dashboard read
dashboards.list amplitude.api.dashboards.list list all dashboards in the project read
events.getlist amplitude.api.events.getlist list all event types tracked in the project read
events.identifyuser amplitude.api.events.identifyuser set or update user properties via the identify api write
events.upload amplitude.api.events.upload upload one or more events to amplitude via http api v2 write
events.uploadbatch amplitude.api.events.uploadbatch batch upload events to amplitude write
exports.getdata amplitude.api.exports.getdata export raw event data for a given time range as a zip archive read
users.getactivity amplitude.api.users.getactivity get recent event activity for a specific user read
